name: Jid API
description: Before an agent pays, signs, books, hires or buys, Jid checks the business it is dealing with: real, active, licensed for this activity, not sanctioned, with the receipts. Every fact is cited to the registry that issued it. Decisions apply the published rules (https://jid.com/decision-rules, version 2026-10-09.1) and are not legal advice. No key: 10 requests a minute and 100 a day per IP. A free key (no card) includes 1,000 checks a month. Business information only; not a consumer report and not for FCRA purposes.
